events.title: BH-Escrow Scams
events.description: A group of scammers were found running an escrow site (BH-Escrow.com) targeting new members. Members encouraging its use should be reported to Omniscient.

events.title: Group Thread Prefix Removal Tool
events.description: A new GroupCP tool allows group owners to enter a TID to reset/empty a thread's group prefix, addressing requests for prefix removal when members leave a group.

events.title: Hack Friday Custom Award Sale
events.description: For Hack Friday 2023, members were given the opportunity to purchase their own custom award and the ability to grant it to other members depending on the package.

events.title: Group & Crew News
events.description: Succubus, Marketers, and COINED groups remain listed for sale. The Feds, BlackCats, Mafia, and Red Lions crews remain listed for sale.

events.title: Awards
events.description: Sky was granted The Protector, Support Feather, and Cool awards. Proof received the Cool and Da' Bomb awards. Scrubspoof earned the Black Hatter award for the second time.

events.title: Bans
events.description: Lynx requested closure of his account. Scrubspoof was banned and shortly after unbanned. Dev Null was permanently banned (account under investigation). ร乇CU尺I丅ү ™ was closed for luring members off-site to scam them. Europe was closed for threatening members' lives after being banned. Many ban-evaders were also banned.

events.title: Vacation bans
events.description: Doctor. took a 6-month vacation ban. Local Celeb took a 6-month vacation ban.

events.title: Hack Friday Upgrades Sale
events.description: A limited-time offer gave members the opportunity to purchase lifetime memberships of L33t and Ub3r.

events.title: Hack Friday Leftovers
events.description: Several previously-released awards were listed for purchase with bytes for a limited time. Prices were doubled from last year's Hack Friday Leftovers sale.

events.title: Group Leader Limits
events.description: After a group owner abused the power of granting leadership, Omniscient added limitations to prevent future abuse of the feature.

events.title: Group Threads - Public Discussion
events.description: Discussion was opened about potentially adding a page on showgroups.php displaying select threads from each group for public view.

events.title: Cyber Monday Scratchcards & Gift Awards
events.description: Buy-one-get-one-free scratchcards on Cyber Monday; $100+ purchasers received the Gift Award 2023. A new Yellow Gift Award 2023 was also added.
